task.closedMessage: This task is already finished and cannot take another message

name.length: Use 2 to 16 characters for the name

bio.length: The bio can be at most 80 characters
bio.default: An agent published by a person.

schema.pair: Write the input and output JSON Schema together

skill.shape: A skill needs a name and what it can finish
skill.name: Use 1 to 24 characters for the skill name
skill.description: Use 1 to 120 characters for the skill description
skill.type: skill must be a skill name
skill.missing: This person does not list that skill

card.schemaNote: params.skillSchemas lists the input each skill expects and the output it hands back. Text and numbers go in JSON. A field with contentMediaType image/* is an image: send a separate image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, or image/gif part, with raw base64 or an http address.
card.roster: onDuty lists people who are on duty, the skills they wrote, and each person's url. The model picks one person and sends SendMessage to that url. configuration.returnImmediately must be true.
card.person: The skills this person wrote say what they can finish. They appear in the discovery list after going on duty. SendMessage must set configuration.returnImmediately to true, and the result is picked up with GetTask.{schemaNote}
card.dispatcher: Find people who are on duty. Each person's skills say what they can finish. Pick one and send SendMessage to their url.
card.discoverDescription: Read onDuty. It lists people on duty, skill descriptions, and call addresses. The directory does not assign work.

duty.notHuman: This card does not go on duty
duty.type: Duty status must be true or false
duty.needsSkill: Write at least one skill before going on duty

artifact.owner: Only the person on this task can submit the work
artifact.waiting: The work is already in. Waiting for the model to score it.
artifact.length: Use 1 to 4000 characters for the artifact
artifact.name: Artifact

output.bad: The output format does not match
output.misaligned: This output schema does not line up
output.oneImage: The output can include only one image
output.imageOnly: This output is only an image
output.fieldsNotText: Submit the output as fields, not free text
output.fields: The output must be these fields
output.schemaRequired: Submit the output as JSON matching the schema
output.jsonNotText: The output must be JSON, not free text

status.owner: Only the person on this task can change the status

request.body: The request body is not JSON

identity.failed: Could not read this browser's card

image.types: Images must be png, jpeg, webp, or gif
image.base64: The image content must be base64
image.mismatch: The image content does not match its type
image.needsData: The image needs base64 or an http address
image.url: The image must be an http address, or data:image/png;base64,…

caller.name: External model
caller.bio: A caller that arrived over JSON-RPC. It does not take tasks. It only sends work to people.

command.length: Use 1 to {max} characters for the instruction

context.mismatch: contextId does not match this task

score.noImage: A score does not take an image
score.expired: The model did not score, so this score is canceled.
score.range: The score must be an integer from 1 to 5
score.needsTask: A score needs the task id

human.only: You can only direct a person who has published

cancel.protocol: Only a task sent over the protocol can be canceled here
cancel.closed: This task is already finished and cannot be canceled

working.poll: The person is still working. Poll the artifact with GetTask.

submitted.poll: The task has not been sent to a person yet. Poll with GetTask.

parts.required: parts need text, JSON, or an image

part.kind: Only text, JSON, or an image is accepted

push.unsupported: Push notifications are not supported. Poll with GetTask.

modes.type: acceptedOutputModes must be an array of strings
modes.kind: Only text, JSON, or an image is returned

returnImmediately: Set configuration.returnImmediately to true. While the person is on duty the task is dispatched immediately, then picked up with GetTask.

directory.assign: Pick someone from onDuty and send SendMessage to that person's url. The directory does not assign work.

page.size: pageSize must be an integer from 1 to 100

protocolStatus.unknown: status is not a protocol state

stream.unsupported: Streaming is not supported. Use SendMessage, then poll GetTask.

mcp.instructions: Clients that speak A2A read the discovery URL /.well-known/agent-card.json, pick someone from onDuty, and send SendMessage to that person's url. This MCP endpoint is a fallback: each on-duty skill is a tool, and the call still goes to that person's own A2A address. While the person is working, call again with task_id. After they deliver, the result is a score request; call again with task_id and score.
mcp.imageDescription: An http address for the image, or data:image/png;base64,…
mcp.promptDescription: What this person should do. A JSON object or array is sent as application/json.
mcp.taskIdDescription: The task id to send while the person is still working, asking for more input, or asking for a score.
mcp.scoreDescription: A score from 1 to 5 for the person who did this task. Fill it only when the result asks for a score.
mcp.toolPath: A client that speaks A2A should send SendMessage straight to this person's address. Calls here still go through that person's A2A. While they are working, call again with only task_id. If the result asks for a score, call again with task_id and score.
mcp.stillWorking: The person is still working. Call the same tool again with task_id set to {id}.
mcp.emptyArtifact: The person handed back an empty artifact
mcp.fieldsRequired: Fill in what this skill asks for.
mcp.getOnly: This fallback endpoint only accepts POST. Clients that speak A2A should read the discovery URL.
